# GMEOW Citations Module

The GMEOW Citations Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/citations>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/citations`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Citation, credit, and attribution — the universal CitationAct relator,
Contribution degree, and selector vocabulary. Replaces the old sources.ttl evidence link
with a typed, reified citation relator and an anti-rigid SourceRole. Bridges to CiTO,
CRediT, PROV-O, and PAV by reference (Principle 5).

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/citations>
